ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55% high-intensity (off-white) to 45% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) contiguous region extending from the peduncle attachment to the mid-lobe. High-intensity (white) regions occupy the outer lateral lobes. Significant black mottling and focal spotting are present within the white regions, particularly on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped notch with a wide calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a low depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge with a symmetrical sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, circular low-intensity spots observed near the trailing edge of the right lobe and at the distal tips, consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible: a prominent diagonal streak on the mid-left lobe and several thinner vertical marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged indentation on the distal margin of the right fluke tip indicative of minor past tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, large diagonal black linear mark originating near the top-center of the left lobe's white region.
